meta.name: onboarding
meta.description: When the user wants to optimize post-signup onboarding, user activation, first-run experience, or time-to-value. Also use when the user mentions "onboarding flow," "activation rate," "user activation," "first-run experience," "empty states," "onboarding checklist," "aha moment," "new user experience," "users aren't activating," "nobody completes setup," "low activation rate," "users sign up but don't use the product," "time to value," or "first session experience." Use this whenever users are signing up but not sticking around. For signup/registration optimization, see signup. For ongoing email sequences, see emails.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 优化注册后的首次使用流程,提升用户激活率
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果用户注册后留不住,不知道如何优化激活环节
copy.tagline_en: Optimize the first-run experience to boost activation and retention
copy.fit_line_en: For you if users sign up but don't activate and you need to improve the first-run experience.

howto.what: Claude 会作为新手引导优化专家，先了解产品类型、激活定义和当前状态，再分析流失环节，并输出带优先级的问题清单、引导流程设计、检查清单和邮件触发方案等。
howto.when: 当你想优化注册后的引导、用户激活或首次体验等，或提到“onboarding flow”“激活率”等关键词，以及用户注册了却不使用时触发。

say.text: 我的用户注册后都不激活，怎么改进引导流程？
say.note: Claude 会先了解产品背景，再分析流失点并给出优化建议。

say.text: 帮我设计一个新手引导检查清单。
say.note: Claude 会按价值优先列出 3-7 项清单，并说明用法。

say.text: 分析一下我的激活漏斗哪里流失最多。
say.note: Claude 会分析每个步骤的流失率，并给出优先处理项。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as an onboarding optimization expert. It first gathers product context, activation definition, and current state, then identifies drop-off points and produces a prioritized issue list, onboarding flow design, checklists, and email trigger plans.
howto.when_en: Triggers when optimizing post-signup onboarding, user activation, or first-run experience; mentioning keywords like 'onboarding flow' or 'activation rate'; or when users sign up but don't stick.

say_en.text: My users sign up but don't activate. How can I improve the onboarding flow?
say_en.note: Claude will assess your flow and suggest optimizations.

say_en.text: Design an onboarding checklist for my product.
say_en.note: Claude will create a value-ordered checklist of 3-7 items.

say_en.text: Analyze where my activation funnel drops off the most.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze step-by-step drop-offs and prioritize fixes.
